name: desktop-habitats
description: Living desktop scenes for macOS, starting with Riverscape, a freshwater aquarium.

scripts.check: node --check serve.mjs && for f in scenes/*/src/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && sh wallpaper/tests/check.sh
scripts.test: node scenes/riverscape/tests/fish-behavior.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/mixed-fish.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/breeding.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/render-policy.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/plant-budget.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/tank-state.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/tank-save.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/turtle.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/verification.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/verification-report.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/verification-checklist.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/verification-doctor.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/verification-native.mjs && sh wallpaper/tests/run.sh
